answer: The bridge explorer exposes the whole merge tree. Splitting into 2 separate vaults requires a separate funded nadir account and a separate escrow deposit for each, so that the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. That is 4 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
